description: This file defines a URL class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, including URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and key-value handling functionalities. It provides mechanisms to represent and manipulate URLs, including scheme types, user info, host, port, path, query, and fragment components.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Represents a URL with parsing, validation, and encoding functionalities, supporting various URL schemes and components.

classes.name: URL::KeyValue
classes.description: Handles key-value pairs within URL query strings, providing methods to access, check existence, and convert values.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Returns the full URL as a string.

methods.name: URL::IsDomain
methods.description: Checks if the host matches a given domain string.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into URL-encoded format.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into Base64 format.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL.
